result.rationale: In group.js, removeMember calls self.findMembers() immediately; findMembers computes `offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0))` using the client-side user_count, which is only updated in the response (self.setProperties). After deleting the last member of the last page, the stale (higher) user_count permits an offset beyond the new total, so the server returns an empty list while earlier pages still have members. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: Removing the last member of the last page leaves the admin on an empty page because the `findMembers` offset clamp (`Math.min(this.get("user_count"), ...)`) uses the stale pre-mutation `user_count`, so the request keeps the old offset and the server returns an empty list while members still exist
